law.catch_line: Authority to receive and grant funds
law.text:
Subject to regulations of the Board and to the availability of state or federal funds for services to the victims of domestic violence, the Department is authorized to:
Receive state and federal funds for services to the victims of domestic violence;
Disperse funds through matching grants to local, public or private nonprofit agencies to provide service programs for the victims of domestic violence; and
Develop and implement grant mechanisms for funding such local services.
